method: C3 GRU-only Natural coverage adaptation with paired anchors and target-chart distribution/response-share losses
Real_Encoder_Decoder: original frozen C3, NOT C13 or C26
Translator: original C3 two-layer GRU181824 parameters, initialized from C3 best checkpoint
GMM: existing dictionary480 and physical paired1200/240 unchanged, no new pairing or physics
loss: original pairHuber+.1 frozenRealDecoder NLL + lambda_m Real-chart mean/covariance + lambda_s source patch response-share
moment_scope: Translator output vs Real posterior ONLY in Real-chart; no direct independent-latent distance, no OT
source_structure: squared patch share difference, array-index proxy NOT certified physical map; sigmoidMask*GammaMean smooth readout for training only; original hardMAP decoder at deployment
weight_rule: each new term initially25% of Train anchor magnitude (Huber+.1 abs NLL); one fixed choice, no C0 feedback
loss_scaling_mean_std: RealTrain-only loss coordinates, NOT input/C0 Scaler; never applied to deployed tactile
selection: Validation same composite objective, no C0; both paired and Natural validation/Real reference latent moments
optimizer: AdamW new state, original GRU lr
